notes.title: Anniversary Update is now live!
notes.content:
Dear Red Panda Resistance members,

we are happy to present to you our anniversary update that brings [b]3 new secret bosses[/b] and an additional [b]red panda class[/b] to the mix.

[h3]Tomoko joins the Pandaparty[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842327/cbd348625e061e12f926bbe4fe63adaaa4117d39.png[/img]

The new red panda class is the [b]Mimic[/b]. Tomoko, doesn't have her own set of starting abilities, BUT she can copy most abilities that other Pandamembers perform during combat. Having her in your party can let you double up on powerful spells owned by other pandas, without having to hunt for a second copy of a certain spell. Pair her with panda's who have powerful, but unrepeatable abilities to gain a huge advantage in combat!

[h3]Secret Bosses are here[/h3]

We added 3 brand new bosses for the anniversary event for those who are looking for even more challenges. These enemies replace the normal end of chapter boss fights for all 3 acts with lot harder encounters. These bosses are completely new and have a unique set of abilities. Be ready for anything!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842327/cf1cc91493cf640cd8dba4b34b88c7abc9a35416.png[/img]

In order to be able to face these bosses, you need to have completed the game at least once. After that, you simply need to start a new run and equip a new Booster item called: [b]Challengers Pendant[/b] (it's automatically added to your inventory during the beginning of a run after beating the game). Make sure to equip it before starting any combat to activate the secret bosses.

Defeating all 3 secret bosses grants you a Steam achievement and unlocks the [b]"Hungry-Hungry-Hiro" skin[/b] for Hiro (battle UI only).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842327/5bf1880e3a693f8345d4acbbd72157d09a40676b.png[/img]

[h3]Minor Changes[/h3]

[list]
[*]Wild Growth (spell) has been changed. Now it has only 1 Charge and a 4 turn Preparation time. The original was simply too strong, it deleted half of the HP of bosses with a single use. The new version is still powerful, but harder to set up.
[*]Fixed some well hidden typos
[/list]

This wraps up our first year of the game. We hope you had and[b] will have[/b] a lot of fun playing and as usual, have a pandastic day!

notes.title: Update Notes for January 21
notes.content: This is a small technical update in preparation for the content update coming in Spring. Stay tuned! :)

notes.title: Patch 1.3.1 is now live!
notes.content:
This minor update addresses unintended game interactions and reworks some existing spells. You can find the list of impactful changes below:


[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
Fixed an issue that prevented certain Relics and Jewels from appearing in shops.

[b]New Relic:[/b]
Chalice of Blood: Reduces the Health cost of Blood Spells by 40%. (Works great with the new spells from the last update *wink-wink*)

[b]Chiaki's Starting Abilities Reworked:[/b]

[list]
[*] Slow: Now deals Arcane damage to one enemy and causes their next ability to trigger extra Chill Time. Mana cost increased to 15. (Note: If the enemy’s ability already has a Chill Time, it will stack with the extra Chill Time from Slow.)
[*] Time Lock: Now deals Devastating Arcane damage to one enemy and forces them to skip their current turn. Fury cost increased to 55.
[/list]
[b]Boss Ability Update:[/b]

Divine Intervention (Final Boss): This ability no longer locks all starting spells for all pandamembers. 
Instead, it locks only the original starting spell of the targeted pandamember.
(For example: Hiro's starting spell Renew will be locked for him, but if Renew is known by any other pandamembers, they will still be able to use it.)

This concludes the key changes for this patch.

We hope you’ve enjoyed the 3 extra characters introduced this year, and we’re excited to bring you even more content and updates in 2025. Happy Holidays, and see you in Spring! 🎉

notes.title: Goosebumps season is here! Adnap, the red panda vampire, joins the battle!
notes.content:
It's time to get spooky with [b]Adnap, the red panda vampire[/b]. Adnap is a master of Blood-type spells, sacrificing his own health for powerful effects and feasting on defeated enemies. He is now recruitable in-game the same way as other red pandas were before. You don't need to do anything special to unlock him.

[b]Adnap comes with 4 brand new spells and a unique passive effect:[/b]

[list]
[*]Hellfire 🦇: Sacrifice 666 Health to deal Flame damage to all enemies and an additional 666 damage over 3 turns.
[*]Boiling Blood: Deals Flame damage based on the amount of Health spent on spells by all Pandamembers this combat. (66 Fury)
[*]Dark Renewal: Fully Restores the User's Health and grants Renew. (66 Mana)
[*]Symphony of the Night 🦇: Sacrifice 466 Health to grant all Pandamembers a Health draining ability.
[*]Vampiric Aura (Passive): Whenever a non-boss enemy is defeated, restore Health, Mana or Fury to all Pandamembers. The restoration effect varies depending on type of enemy defeated.
[/list]

These new spells can also be found in shops and as rewards after combat.

[b]Blood Spells are now also in the game.[/b] Seven old spells got a blood variant with this patch:

[olist]
[*]Blood Eather 🦇: Sacrifice 500 Health to restore 40 Mana to a Pandamember. (Swift)
[*]Bloodball 🦇: Sacrifice 300 Health to deal High Flame damage to one enemy. (Swift)
[*]Bloody Mary 🦇: Sacrifice 400 Health to boost a Pandamember's Max Health by 20% and grant them 20 Fury each turn for 5 turns. (Swift)
[*]Fury of Blood 🦇: Sacrifice 999 Health to deal 1000 Stone damage equally split between all enemies. (Swift, Limited uses: 1x)
[*]Blood Blitz 🦇: Sacrifice 666 Health to deal Sky damage to all enemies. (Swift)
[*]Ancestral Blood 🦇: Sacrifice 500 Health to increase all Pandamember's experience earned by 50%. (Swift)
[*]Dawn of Blood 🦇: Sacrifice 🦇 777 Health to apply Renew to all Pandamembers. (Swift)
[/olist]

These new variants can now show up in shops and battle rewards.

This concludes the list of the major changes to the game for this patch. We hope you will also enjoy the new content, and as usual, let us know what you think and keep being awesome!

We will see you again after the holiday season. [b]We wish you a goosebumpy, spooky season![/b]

notes.title: Ginger spices up the battle!
notes.content:
Ginger is here to spice up the rest of your summer! She specializes in [b]Auto-Trigger abilities[/b] and instantly [b]harvests plant type enemies[/b]. She is now also recruitable in-game the same way as other red pandas before. You don't need to do anything to unlock her.

[b]Ginger has 4 brand new spells and a unique passive ability:[/b]
[list]
[*] Flower Power: Deals Arcane damage to a random enemy. This ability can't trigger enemy reactions. Auto-Trigger when a Pandamember uses an ability on a friendly target
[*] Wild Growth: Deals Stone damage [b]12[/b] times to random enemies. (100 Fury, 2 Charges)
[*] Pollen Cloud: Deals Low Void damage to all enemies. Enemies have 50% chance to also become poisoned. (1 turn Chill Time)
[*] Photosynthesis: Restores a small amount of Health and 10 Fury to the User. Auto-Trigger when a Glory ability is used by other Pandamembers
[*] Herbalist (Passive): Forces all plant type enemies to instantly yield at the start of combat. (Your party still receives all types of rewards as normal.)
[/list]
These new spells can also be found in shops and as rewards after combat.

[b]A new type of weapon was also added to the game:[/b]
[list]
[*] Futuristic Watch: Reduces the Chill Time of all spells by 20%. Stats: +100HP +5MP
[*] Futuristic Smart Watch: Reduces the Chill Time of all spells by 40%. Stats: +200HP +10MP
[*] Futuristic AI Watch: Reduces the Chill Time of all spells by 50%. Stats: +400HP +20MP
[/list]
These new weapons can also appear now in shops and in battle rewards!

[b]Controller Input[/b]
With the help of the Steam Input system, you can now also use different kinds of controllers to play the game. More information on how to use and set up controllers can be found [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2787630/discussions/0/4518883844572218309/]here[/url].

We have also added an achievement for completing the game with the new character and tweaked the stats of some enemies and classes for better overall balancing.

This concludes the list of the major changes to the game for this patch. We hope you will also enjoy the new content, and as usual, let us know what you think and keep being awesome!

We will see you again during the fall content update. Have a pandastic day!

notes.title: Antoine, the Little Prince joins the battle!
notes.content:
The wait is over, Antoine has arrived to save the day. This [b]new support type character[/b] is now also recruitable in-game the same way as other red pandas before. You don't need to do anything to unlock him.

[b]Antoine has 4 brand new spells and a unique passive ability:[/b]
[list]
[*] Tax Charge: Deals High Flame damage to one enemy and adds 10 Gold to your inventory. (2 turns Chill Time)
[*] Blessing of Kings: Fully restores the Health and Mana of a fellow Pandamember and grants them Renew, Protein Shake, Bravery and Arcane Harmony. (50 Fury, 2 Charges, 2 turns preparation)
[*] Royal Fanfare: Restores a small amount of health to all Pandamembers and decreases their pending Chill Times by 1 turn.
[*] Sacré Bleu!: Deals Glory damage to one enemy. Damage dealt by this ability increases each time it's used by any Pandamembers. (Damage resets after each run. 2 turns Chill Time)
[*] To Battle! (Passive): At the start of battle boosts a random Pandamember's Health, Mana, Might, Spirit, Defense and Speed by 10% for this combat.
[/list]

These new spells can also be found in shops and as rewards after combat.

[b]Seven new upgraded spells have been added to the game:[/b]
[list]
[*] Restore Chi ☆: grants 90 Fury (the basic version gives 60)
[*] Pyroblast ☆: Has 50% less Chill Time compared to the basic version
[*] Absorb Water ☆: grants 2 times more mana as the basic version
[*] Leg Sweep ☆:  has 2 charges
[*] Preparation ☆: Has 50% less Chill Time compared to the basic version
[*] Impending Doom ☆: Has 50% less Chill Time compared to the basic version
[*] Divine Ether ☆: Restores 2 times more mana
[/list]

These upgraded spells can also appear now in shops and in battle rewards!

We have also added an achievement for completing the game with the new character and tweaked the stats of some enemies and classes for better overall balancing.

This concludes the list of the major changes to the game for this patch. We hope you will also enjoy the new content, and as usual, let us know what you think and keep being awesome!

We will see you again during the summer content update. Have a pandastic day!

notes.title: Content Update Plan for 2024
notes.content:
We are happy to announce our content update schedule for 2024. We plan to do [b]3 major content updates[/b] this year: the first update will arrive just in a few weeks, in the middle of May! It features, a new character, new spells and minor balance changes. More details about this update will be shared closer to its release date, but you might want to look at the cover picture for a hint about the new character. [i]*wink-wink*[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842327/ab41c9158926fb1e550eecb040083af7ee0c1fed.png[/img]
Our goal with these updates is to encourage existing players to revisit the game and to get more people interested in this goofy adventure.

Also, [b]all of these updates will be [u]free[/u][/b], and the new content will be playable immediately, they won't require any kind of unlocking.

Stay tuned for future updates!

notes.title: Patch v1,06,1 is now live!
notes.content: Today's patch is a small hotfix: I fixed an issue that would sometimes crash the game when facing Hexmistress HIlda, while having the Chaotic Ice Cream buff. Feel free to embrace the chaos now! :)

notes.title: Hotfix Patch 04.08.
notes.content:
This a is a small hotfix for addressing some small UI and encryption issues.

In addition, 2 spells have been adjusted and slightly changed for better interaction with other spells. The changed spells are: Flaming Passion and Snowball Fight.

As usual, let us know if you find any issues and as usual, thanks for being awesome and playing the game!

notes.title: Patch 1.06 is now live
notes.content:
Today's patch contains a few small UI and gameplay fixes:

 - Fixed a bug that could occur in Shops causing players to see incorrect information on buying items
 - Fixed an issue with the in-game mouse conflicting with the default Windows mouse
 - Fixed an issue on the character screen where some UI elements would sometimes overlap the 'Unequip" button
 - Fixed on issue with boss health in Challenge Mode 9
 - Added a few missing sound effects for some dialogs
 - Doom effects now do not reset when reapplied
 - Fixed some text effects in certain dialogs
 - Updated the tooltip of some spells/armors/journal entries to display the correct information

Let us know if you encounter any bugs and issues while playing! Thanks for playing and have a pandastic day!

notes.title: Patch 1.05 is now live
notes.content:
Today's patch contains a few small fixes regarding certain interactions:

- Fixed an issue with Cyber Security Engineer's Firewall dealt incorrect damage
- Reduced healing done by Worshipper of the Feather
- Fixed the damage scaling of Big Brain Bash (it now deals the correct amount)
- Fixed an issue in the Journal where it would display incorrect information regarding certain enemies
- Fixed an interaction between Snowball Fight and Pressure Point
- Updated the description of some spells and equipment for better clarity
- Updated some text strings in dialogs

Thanks for your submissions and let me know if you find anything while you play.
Have fun and slay some geese for me!

notes.title: The Wrath of the Goose King is here!
notes.content: The wait is over: the geese and the red pandas are here! Grab your ice cream with your favorite pandamembers and show the geese who is boss! The fate of the kingdom is in your paws.
